claims.text: The reported hardware evaluation covers CIFAR-10 and CelebA-HQ 256×256 on Jetson Orin Nano, averages energy and latency over 500 generations with 95% confidence intervals, and computes FID on 50,000 images.
On CIFAR-10 using Jetson Orin Nano, EAD-Diff at B=0.3 reports FID 5.23±0.20, energy 0.58±0.02 J, and latency 201±7 ms.
On CIFAR-10 using Raspberry Pi 5 CPU inference, EAD-Diff at B=0.5 reports FID 4.57±0.18, energy 4.98±0.15 J, and latency 1675±50 ms.

method: EAD-Diff conditions latent-token pruning and denoising-step scheduling on a normalized device energy budget and trains the adaptations with an energy-aware objective.
problem: Diffusion image generation is computationally and energy intensive for mobile and edge deployment, while fixed inference schedules do not adapt to changing device energy constraints.
